## Plants vs Zombies Game - Java Implementation

This is a JavaFX-based Plants vs Zombies game project.

### Project Setup Checklist

- [x] Create project structure and configuration
- [x] Scaffold the project with core game classes
- [x] Customize the project with game mechanics
- [x] Install required extensions (Extension Pack for Java)
- [x] Create and run task configuration
- [x] Ensure documentation is complete
- [ ] Compile the project (requires Maven or JavaFX SDK)
- [ ] Launch the project (once compiled)

### Key Features to Implement
- Game board with grid-based plant/zombie placement
- Different plant and zombie types with unique abilities
- Wave-based enemy spawning system
- Collision detection and game physics
- UI with JavaFX
- Game state management (playing, paused, game over)
- Sound effects and animations (optional)

### Build and Run
The project uses Maven for build management. Standard Maven commands apply.
